name: Goalie
summary: Goalie is a virtual reality game that puts you in the shoes of a goalkeeper. The game is suitable for all ages and offers a calming, minimalistic design that is easy on the eyes. It is great for daily exercise and helps improve your goalkeeping skills. With Goalie, you'll be able to practice your reflexes and hand-eye coordination in a fun and immersive environment.
